text: Chinese philosophy is a comprehensive discipline that focuses on the exploration of the unique cosmology, values, and ways of thinking of the Chinese nation, as well as their historical evolution based on traditional Chinese philosophical thoughts. It not only involves the compilation and interpretation of ancient philosophical texts, but also pays more attention to uncovering the enlightenment that traditional wisdom can bring to contemporary society, culture, and human civilization. It is an important way to understand the core of Chinese cultural spirit. From the Hundred Schools of Thought of the pre-Qin scholars to the meticulous speculation of Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism, from the "benevolence and propriety" doctrine of Confucianism to the "harmony between heaven and man" philosophy of Taoism, the ideological thread of Chinese philosophy has run through thousands of years, shaping the spiritual temperament of the Chinese nation.
